scripts.title: Server Teleport
scripts.script:
-- Server Teleport GUI (Versi dengan Min Player Setting)
-- Bisa drag, minimize jadi ikon bulat, dan atur minimal jumlah player server

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

-- ====== Request Handler ======
local function doRequest(req)
    if syn and syn.request then
        return syn.request(req)
    elseif request then
        return request(req)
    elseif http and http.request then
        return http.request(req)
    elseif http_request then
        return http_request(req)
    else
        error("Executor tidak support HTTP Request.")
    end
end

-- ====== Server API ======
local function getServers(placeId, cursor, minPlayers)
    local url = ("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100"):format(placeId)
    if cursor then
        url = url .. "&cursor=" .. cursor
    end
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        return doRequest({
            Url = url,
            Method = "GET",
            Headers = {["User-Agent"] = "Roblox/Windows"}
        })
    end)
    if not ok or not res then return nil end
    if res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return nil end
    local body = res.Body or res.body
    local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(body)

    -- Filter minPlayers
    local filtered = {}
    if data and data.data then
        for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
            if server.playing and server.playing >= minPlayers then
                table.insert(filtered, server)
            end
        end
        data.data = filtered
    end
    return data
end

-- ====== GUI ======
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ServerTeleportGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 180)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.25, 0)
frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
frame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,10)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 30)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,6)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Server Teleport"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
title.TextScaled = true
title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold

local countryBox = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
countryBox.PlaceholderText = "Tulis Nama Negara (contoh: Indonesia)"
countryBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 30)
countryBox.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,40)
countryBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
countryBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
countryBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
countryBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
countryBox.TextSize = 16
Instance.new("UICorner", countryBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

local minPlayerBox = Instance.new("TextBox", frame)
minPlayerBox.PlaceholderText = "Minimal Player (contoh: 10)"
minPlayerBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 30)
minPlayerBox.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,76)
minPlayerBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
minPlayerBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
minPlayerBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
minPlayerBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
minPlayerBox.TextSize = 16
minPlayerBox.Text = "10" -- default
Instance.new("UICorner", minPlayerBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

local teleportBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
teleportBtn.Text = "Find & Teleport"
teleportBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 36)
teleportBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0,116)
teleportBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,135,255)
teleportBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
teleportBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
teleportBtn.TextSize = 16
Instance.new("UICorner", teleportBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

local stopBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
stopBtn.Text = "Stop"
stopBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0, 36)
stopBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 116)
stopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,60,60)
stopBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
stopBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
stopBtn.TextSize = 16
Instance.new("UICorner", stopBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

-- Minimize
local minBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
minBtn.Text = "—"
minBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,28,0,28)
minBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6)
minBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
minBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
minBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
minBtn.TextSize = 20
Instance.new("UICorner", minBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)

local miniIcon = Instance.new("ImageButton", screenGui)
miniIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0,56,0,56)
miniIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0.02,0,0.8,0)
miniIcon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
miniIcon.Visible = false
Instance.new("UICorner", miniIcon).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

local miniLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", miniIcon)
miniLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
miniLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
miniLabel.Text = "ST"
miniLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
miniLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
miniLabel.TextScaled = true

-- ====== Drag ======
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local function makeDraggable(obj)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = obj.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    obj.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                                     startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end
makeDraggable(frame)
makeDraggable(miniIcon)

minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    frame.Visible = false
    miniIcon.Visible = true
end)
miniIcon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    frame.Visible = true
    miniIcon.Visible = false
end)

-- ====== Teleport Logic ======
local searching = false
teleportBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if searching then return end
    local targetCountry = countryBox.Text
    local minPlayers = tonumber(minPlayerBox.Text) or 10
    if targetCountry == "" then
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="Isi nama negara dulu!",Duration=3})
        return
    end
    searching = true
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="Mencari server ("..minPlayers.."+) untuk "..targetCountry,Duration=4})

    spawn(function()
        local placeId = game.PlaceId
        local data = getServers(placeId,nil,minPlayers)
        if not data or not data.data or #data.data == 0 then
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="Tidak ada server dengan "..minPlayers.." pemain ditemukan.",Duration=4})
            searching = false
            return
        end
        local sid = data.data[math.random(1,#data.data)].id
        local ok, err = pcall(function()
            TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, sid, Player)
        end)
        if not ok then
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="Teleport gagal: "..tostring(err),Duration=4})
        end
        searching = false
    end)
end)

stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    searching = false
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="Pencarian dihentikan.",Duration=3})
end)

StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification",{Title="Server Teleport",Text="GUI siap! Isi negara + minimal player, lalu klik Find & Teleport.",Duration=5})
scripts.features:
1. GUI Name: Server Teleport – modern design, draggable and minimizable into a round icon.


2. Country Input: Type a country name (e.g., Indonesia, USA) to search for servers in that region.


3. Player Filter: Includes a box to set minimum player count, so you won’t land in empty servers.


4. Default Setting: Minimum players automatically set to 10 (editable).


5. Drag Feature: The main frame can be freely moved around the screen.


6. Minimize Feature: GUI can be minimized into a round “ST” icon at the corner.


7. Round Icon: The icon is draggable and can be clicked to reopen the GUI.


8. Teleport Button: The main button to start searching and teleporting into servers.


9. Stop Button: Allows you to cancel the search process at any time.


10. GUI Notifications: All actions show notifications (success, fail, stop, etc).


11. Server Filtering: Only selects servers that meet the minimum player requirement.


12. Random Server Pick: Randomly selects one of the filtered servers to avoid repetition.


13. Auto Request: Uses Roblox official API to fetch server data.


14. Cross-Executor Support: Works with executors that support HTTP requests (Synapse, Script-Ware, Arceus Neo, etc).


15. Empty Input Warning: If the country field is empty, a “Please enter a country name!” notification appears.


16. Fail Protection: Shows notification if no servers are found.


17. Clean UI: Modern dark design with rounded corners.


18. Fast Search: Instantly fetches server data in real-time.


19. Cursor Support: Can continue fetching from the next server page (multi-page search).


20. Custom Size GUI: Medium-sized frame (360x180), suitable for small and large screens.


21. Multi-Device Friendly: Works smoothly on both mobile and PC.


22. No Reset Loss: GUI remains visible even after character reset.


23. Clear Text Control: Country input does not auto-clear when focused, easy to edit.


24. Manual Save: Minimum players can be adjusted anytime without reload.


25. Flexible Range: Minimum player filter can be set from 1 to 100.


26. Crowded Server Mode: Perfect for hunting active/populated servers.


27. Low Player Mode: Can also search for small/quiet servers by lowering min players.


28. Full Control: Search and stop are fully managed with GUI buttons.


29. Simple Use: Just type country + min players + click Teleport.


30. Notification Style: Clear text with color-coded messages (blue/white for info, red for errors).


31. Error Bypass: If teleport fails, the script instantly explains the error cause.

scripts.title: Kill aura Universal
scripts.script:
local connections = getgenv().configs and getgenv().configs.connection
if connections then
    local Disable = configs.Disable
    for i,v in connections do
        v:Disconnect() 
    end
    Disable:Fire()
    Disable:Destroy()
    table.clear(configs)
end

local Disable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
getgenv().configs = {
    connections = {},
    Disable = Disable,
    Size = Vector3.new(10,10,10),
    DeathCheck = true
}

local Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))
local RunService = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
local Run = true
local Ignorelist = OverlapParams.new()
Ignorelist.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

local function getchar(plr)
    local plr = plr or lp
    return plr.Character
end

local function gethumanoid(plr: Player | Character)
    local char = plr:IsA("Model") and plr or getchar(plr)

    if char then
        return char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    end
end

local function IsAlive(Humanoid)
    return Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function GetTouchInterest(Tool)
    return Tool and Tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter",true)
end

local function GetCharacters(LocalPlayerChar)
    local Characters = {}
    for i,v in Players:GetPlayers() do
        table.insert(Characters,getchar(v))
    end
    table.remove(Characters,table.find(Characters,LocalPlayerChar))
    return Characters
end

local function Attack(Tool,TouchPart,ToTouch)
    if Tool:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        Tool:Activate()
        firetouchinterest(TouchPart,ToTouch,1)
        firetouchinterest(TouchPart,ToTouch,0)
    end
end

table.insert(getgenv().configs.connections,Disable.Event:Connect(function()
    Run = false
end))

while Run do
    local char = getchar()
    if IsAlive(gethumanoid(char)) then
        local Tool = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
        local TouchInterest = Tool and GetTouchInterest(Tool)

        if TouchInterest then
            local TouchPart = TouchInterest.Parent
            local Characters = GetCharacters(char)
            Ignorelist.FilterDescendantsInstances = Characters
            local InstancesInBox = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(TouchPart.CFrame,TouchPart.Size + getgenv().configs.Size,Ignorelist)

            for i,v in InstancesInBox do
                local Character = v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

                if table.find(Characters,Character) then
                    if getgenv().configs.DeathCheck then                    
                        if IsAlive(gethumanoid(Character)) then
                            Attack(Tool,TouchPart,v)
                        end
                    else
                        Attack(Tool,TouchPart,v)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end

scripts.title: teamhahaha10 gui v1
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local guiParent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local assets = {
	background = "123925201141701",
	buttonImage = "99732973978252",
	jumpscareSound = "6129291390"
}

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Delta_GUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = guiParent

local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel", gui)
bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 600)
bg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -300, 0.5, -300)
bg.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.background
bg.BackgroundTransparency = 0
bg.BorderSizePixel = 4
bg.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
bg.Active = true
bg.Draggable = true

-- Üst Başlık
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "teamhahaha10 GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextScaled = true

-- R6 ve R15 Butonları (küçük)
local function createRigButton(text, rigType, position)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 30)
	btn.Position = position
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("Players"):SetCharacterAppearanceAsync(player.UserId, rigType)
	end)
end

createRigButton("R6", Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6, UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 5))
createRigButton("R15", Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15, UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 5))

-- Fonksiyonlar ve input alanı
local inputs = {}

local function createImageButton(parent, text, pos, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("ImageButton", parent)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.buttonImage
	btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true

	if callback then
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
	end
end

local function createInput(name, pos)
	local input = Instance.new("TextBox", bg)
	input.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 30)
	input.Position = pos
	input.PlaceholderText = name .. " ID gir"
	input.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	input.TextScaled = true
	input.Text = ""
	input.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	input.BorderSizePixel = 0
	inputs[name] = input
end

-- Uygulama Fonksiyonları
local function applyDecal()
	local id = inputs["decal"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
					local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
					decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
					decal.Face = face
					decal.Parent = part
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applySkybox()
	local id = inputs["skybox"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, obj in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then obj:Destroy() end
		end
		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		for _, face in {"Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up"} do
			sky["Skybox" .. face] = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		end
		sky.Parent = game.Lighting
	end
end

local function applyMusic()
	local id = inputs["music"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		sound.Volume = 1
		sound.Looped = true
		sound:Play()
	end
end

local function applyParticles()
	local id = inputs["particles"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter", part)
				p.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				p.Rate = 30
				p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(2)
				p.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applyJumpscare()
	local id = inputs["jumpscare"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		local jumpscareGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", guiParent)
		local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel", jumpscareGui)
		image.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		image.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1

		local sound = Instance.new("Sound", image)
		sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. assets.jumpscareSound
		sound.Volume = 10
		sound:Play()

		sound.Ended:Connect(function()
			jumpscareGui:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

-- Sol Butonlar
local solButonlar = {
	"🎨 Decal", "🌌 Skybox", "🎵 Music", "✨ Particles", "😱 Jumpscare"
}
for i, text in ipairs(solButonlar) do
	createImageButton(bg, text, UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 60 + (i - 1) * 45), nil)
end

-- Sağ Butonlar ve inputlar
local sagButonlar = {
	{text = "🎨 Decal Ayarla", key = "decal", func = applyDecal},
	{text = "🌌 Skybox Ayarla", key = "skybox", func = applySkybox},
	{text = "🎵 Music Ayarla", key = "music", func = applyMusic},
	{text = "✨ Particles Ayarla", key = "particles", func = applyParticles},
	{text = "😱 Jumpscare Ayarla", key = "jumpscare", func = applyJumpscare}
}
for i, data in ipairs(sagButonlar) do
	local y = 60 + (i - 1) * 75
	createInput(data.key, UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, y))
	createImageButton(bg, data.text, UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, y + 35), data.func)
end

-- TP Butonları
local function createTeleportButton(text, pos, placeId)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		game:GetService("TeleportService"):Teleport(placeId, player)
	end)
end

createTeleportButton("🎯 Game TP 1", UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 460), 8325995630)
createTeleportButton("🎯 Game TP 2", UDim2.new(0.5, 20, 0, 460), 115022519293289)

-- SCARY Buton
local function scaryEffect()
	game.Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	game.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	game.Lighting.FogEnd = 100
	game.Lighting.FogColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local id = assets.background
	for _, obj in pairs(game.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if obj:IsA("Sky") then obj:Destroy() end
	end
	local sky = Instance.new("Sky", game.Lighting)
	for _, face in {"Bk", "Dn", "Ft", "Lf", "Rt", "Up"} do
		sky["Skybox" .. face] = "rbxassetid://" .. id
	end
	for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in pairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal", part)
				decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
				decal.Face = face
			end
			local sel = Instance.new("SelectionBox", part)
			sel.Adornee = part
			sel.LineThickness = 0.05
			sel.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
			local fire = Instance.new("Fire", part)
			fire.Size = 10
			fire.Heat = 10
		end
	end
	game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
		Title = "teamhahaha10!!!!!!",
		Text = "teamhahaha10!!!!!!! Hack hahahaha",
		Duration = 5
	})
	local msg = Instance.new("Message", workspace)
	msg.Text = "teamhahaha10!!!!!!! Hack hahahaha"
	task.delay(5, function()
		msg:Destroy()
	end)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui", guiParent)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame", g)
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
	frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 0.5, -50)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.Text = "666"
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextScaled = true
end

local function createScaryButton()
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 50)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 510)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 0, 0)
	btn.Text = "😈 666 SCARY 😈"
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0)
		scaryEffect()
	end)
end

createScaryButton() -- 🧠 Face All Butonu (Sol tarafa ekle)
createImageButton(bg, "🧠 Face All", UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 60 + (#solButonlar) * 45), function()
	local id = inputs["faceall"] and inputs["faceall"].Text
	if tonumber(id) then
		local head = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head then
			local decal = Instance.new("Decal", head)
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. id
		end
	end
end)

-- Yeni input: Face All için
createInput("faceall", UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 450)) -- Input ve Buton ekle
createInput("shutdown", UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 600))
createImageButton(bg, "🚫 Shutdown", UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 635), function()
	local text = inputs["shutdown"].Text
	if text == "teamhahaha10 hack" then
		game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
			Title = "teamhahaha10",
			Text = "Hack algılandı, oyundan atılıyorsun.",
			Duration = 5
		})
		task.wait(2)
		player:Kick("teamhahaha10 hack")
	end
end) -- Mario.exe Butonu
local function createScriptButton(text, pos, url)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", bg)
	btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
	btn.Text = text
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		loadstring(game:HttpGet(url))()
	end)
end

-- Yeni Butonlar (TP Game 1 ve 2'nin üstüne gelecek)
createScriptButton("🎮 Mario.exe", UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0, 410), "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Mario-exe-scary-mario-script-by-g00byd0lan-42167")
createScriptButton("👻 tuboos93 GUI", UDim2.new(0.5, 20, 0, 410), "https://rawscripts.net/raw/Client-Replication-tuboos93-gui-v3-reupload-31996") -- GUI'nin ortasındaki boş alana efekt butonları (Delta GUI uyumlu)
local centerEffectY = 130 -- üstten mesafe (dikey ortalama)
local centerEffectGap = 45 -- butonlar arası boşluk

local effectButtons = {
    {"🟡 Random Colors", function()
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
            end
        end
    end},

    {"⚡ Glitcher", function()
        for _, part in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local sel = Instance.new("SelectionBox", part)
                sel.Adornee = part
                sel.LineThickness = 0.05
                sel.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(255), math.random(255), math.random(255))
                game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(part, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
                    Transparency = 0.5
                }):Play()
            end
        end
    end},

    {"💃 Disco Başlat", function()
        if discoRunning then return end
        discoRunning = true
        local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
        lighting.Brightness = 5
        lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255)
        lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)
        discoThread = coroutine.create(function()
            while discoRunning do
                lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(math.random(255), math.random(255), math.random(255))
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
        coroutine.resume(discoThread)
    end},

    {"🛑 Disco Durdur", function()
        discoRunning = false
    end},

    {"🔥 Rain Fire", function()
        for i = 1, 100 do
            local firePart = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
            firePart.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
            firePart.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-100, 100), 100, math.random(-100, 100))
            firePart.Anchored = false
            firePart.CanCollide = false
            firePart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red")
            local fire = Instance.new("Fire", firePart)
            fire.Size = 5
            fire.Heat = 8
            task.delay(10, function()
                firePart:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end},

    {"🌈 Rainbow Flood", function()
        for i = 1, 300 do
            local p = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
            p.Anchored = true
            p.Size = Vector3.new(10, 1, 10)
            p.Position = Vector3.new(math.random(-200, 200), 1, math.random(-200, 200))
            p.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
            task.delay(10, function()
                p:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end},
}

for i, data in ipairs(effectButtons) do
    local text, callback = data[1], data[2]
    local btn = Instance.new("ImageButton", bg)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0, centerEffectY + (i - 1) * centerEffectGap)
    btn.Image = "rbxassetid://123925201141701"
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextScaled = true

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end -- Dönen Kare Görsel (Büyük ve GUI ile birlikte hareket eden)
local function createRotatingImage(side)
	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Image = "rbxassetid://123925201141701"
	image.Parent = bg  -- Artık bg'nin içinde, bg ile birlikte hareket eder

	if side == "left" then
		image.Position = UDim2.new(0, -110, 0.5, -50) -- GUI'nin sol dışına
	elseif side == "right" then
		image.Position = UDim2.new(1, 10, 0.5, -50) -- GUI'nin sağ dışına
	end

	local rotation = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			rotation = (rotation + 2) % 360
			image.Rotation = rotation
			task.wait(0.01)
		end
	end)
end

-- Sol ve Sağ yanlara dönen büyük kare ekle (bg ile birlikte hareket eder)
createRotatingImage("left")
createRotatingImage("right")
